title: Orange orb lands near an open Minot missile silo
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: the morning and a UFO came over the base and apparently was like hovering and the guy was screaming like it's it's Landing

plain: Sometime between 1966 and 1968, an orange glowing ball came over Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, a nuclear missile base, hovered, and came down near a missile silo that was open, with a man on the ground "screaming like it's landing." The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells it from his own research for his film The Phenomenon. It is told as a case of an unknown object taking close interest in nuclear weapons.
